work_relationship: Self-employed; own-account; often family helpers unpaid
exposure: Long roadside hours in traffic and dust; evening peaks coincide with sales hours
direct_impacts: Eye, throat and breathing symptoms reported; no measured personal exposure study for Delhi vendors found
secondary_tertiary_impacts: Cannot stop selling without losing daily income; heat and pollution seasons both squeeze earnings; no compensation scheme covers them during restrictions
protective_constraints: No paid leave, no employer, no indoor alternative; WFH advisories irrelevant
community_strengths: Vendor associations and town vending committees exist (not reviewed in depth)
confidence_reason: Exposure inferred from roadside microenvironment studies and testimony; no earnings measurement found

exposure: Landfill and roadside work, waste fires, winter burning for warmth
direct_impacts: 75% abnormal lung function vs 45% in office controls (Delhi, 2023); 17% severe impairment
secondary_tertiary_impacts: Many burn waste or wood to keep warm, adding to exposure; low PPE awareness
protective_constraints: Informal status; no employer duty; protective equipment unknown or unaffordable
community_strengths: Organised by NGOs such as Chintan; long history of waste-picker collectives
confidence_reason: One structured Delhi study with spirometry and control group; cross-sectional

exposure: Street sweeping in dust and traffic, early-morning inversion hours
secondary_tertiary_impacts: Low insurance coverage; health costs fall on households
protective_constraints: Over 60% unaware of PPE; employer (municipal/contractor) obligations not enforced
confidence_reason: Same structured study; association not causation

work_relationship: Wage or daily-wage work through contractors; many migrant
direct_impacts: Respiratory symptoms; women report sickness on high-pollution days
secondary_tertiary_impacts: GRAP stoppages remove wages; compensation only for registered workers; lapsed registrations widespread; some return to villages
protective_constraints: Fear of job loss stops women raising pollution (94% in one survey); registration hurdles
community_strengths: Unions litigating for compensation; MHT-trained women AQI ambassadors
confidence_reason: Policy and payment records plus surveys; income loss documented qualitatively, not measured

group: Drivers, delivery riders and other roadside workers
work_relationship: Platform piece work; own-account (auto drivers); wage (security guards)
exposure: In-traffic exposure far above fixed monitors, especially black carbon and ultrafine particles
direct_impacts: Rider PM2.5 180 µg/m³ and benzene above standard while riding (Ghaziabad, 30 riders); guards 86% abnormal lung function
secondary_tertiary_impacts: Logging off costs income and incentives; social security fund under new code not yet delivering
protective_constraints: No employer under labour law for most; masks rarely used
community_strengths: Platform worker unions campaigning for a pollution surcharge
confidence_reason: Small exposure studies; earnings effects unmeasured

group: Small manufacturing, kiln and industrial workers
work_relationship: Piece-rate family labour (kilns); wage and contract work (industry)
exposure: Coal combustion, dust, heat on site; temporary housing beside kilns
direct_impacts: No adequate health evidence found specific to kiln workers
secondary_tertiary_impacts: Advances create debt bondage; wages withheld for the season; children work
protective_constraints: Paid as family units through male head; women unpaid; seasonal migration
confidence_reason: Labour evidence from advocacy surveys; health evidence absent

exposure: Household air pollution from solid fuel plus ambient infiltration
protective_constraints: Work and cooking share one room
community_strengths: Organised by SEWA and others (air pollution work not found)
confidence_reason: No study located linking home-based work, exposure and earnings

direct_impacts: Lung function falls during burning in Patiala villages
secondary_tertiary_impacts: Costs of residue management fall on farmers; labourers' position unmeasured
protective_constraints: Machinery subsidies reach owners, not labourers
confidence_reason: Village study of 3,644 participants; livelihood effect unmeasured

group: Residents of informal settlements and resettlement colonies
exposure: Ambient plus household fuel plus waste burning; little filtration or cooling
direct_impacts: Symptoms reported; medical spending rises in pollution months
secondary_tertiary_impacts: Health costs compete with food and rent; private protection (AC, purifiers) mostly unaffordable
protective_constraints: Tenancy limits home improvements; few clean indoor spaces
community_strengths: MHT AQI ambassadors; community organising in resettlement colonies
confidence_reason: Survey evidence of inequality in protection; no outcome study

exposure: Continuous outdoor exposure day and night; winter burning for warmth
direct_impacts: No adequate exposure or health study found
secondary_tertiary_impacts: Shelter capacity (about 11,000 places in winter 2026-27) is seasonal and plans list no filtration
protective_constraints: Shelters close in March; no clean daytime space

work_relationship: Wage and piece work across construction, kilns, delivery
exposure: Same as their occupations, plus poor housing
secondary_tertiary_impacts: Lapsed or missing registration excludes them from compensation; families move children with them
protective_constraints: Registration tied to residence and paperwork
confidence_reason: Indirect evidence through registration data and kiln studies

direct_impacts: Higher respiratory complaints among older adults during residue burning; mortality associations in ten-city study
protective_constraints: Less able to avoid exposure if they work outdoors
confidence_reason: General epidemiology; few India-specific age-stratified studies reviewed

exposure: Ambient plus household fuel; work exposure for women in construction and kilns
direct_impacts: Associations with low birthweight and preterm birth in Indian cohorts and NFHS analyses
secondary_tertiary_impacts: Adverse birth outcomes raise later care costs (not quantified here)
protective_constraints: Antenatal services rarely include exposure advice (not documented in reviewed sources)
community_strengths: Women's groups and ASHA networks (not reviewed)
confidence_reason: Consistent associations across Indian studies; effect sizes vary; one RCT (HAPIN) found no birthweight effect from LPG alone

work_relationship: Dependants; some child labour in kilns
direct_impacts: Associations with anaemia, respiratory infection, low birthweight; lung function falls during residue burning; cognitive evidence preliminary
secondary_tertiary_impacts: School closures of up to 15 days shift learning online with unequal access; caregivers lose work time
protective_constraints: Depends on adults and schools for protection
confidence_reason: RCT evidence on school interventions; observational evidence on health

group: People with disabilities or chronic illness
direct_impacts: Named as higher-risk in national health advisory; no Indian outcome studies reviewed
protective_constraints: Mobility limits may reduce ability to reach clean spaces
